body.text: P5's proposer and judge pipeline has strong privilege separation, but judge.py gates beats_linear solely on dev accuracy. As a result, top optdigits proposals on LEADERBOARD.md reach 0.9864 accuracy at 35422 Ir/item (3119 ns/item), 30-60x slower than mlp16/lgn_d, with 113 dev runs not yet checkpointed in ledger/.

body.theme: Solid jail core with specific boundary gaps
body.text: The bwrap + in-jail C compilation + timer.c + scale.py segment check is genuinely hard to game. Two concrete boundary gaps remain: confine-mode valgrind runs without limits.c rlimits (and /w lacks a total disk cap), and seccomp_filter.h defaults to SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW.

Worker orchestration has grown complex to compensate for unreliable free-tier models, introducing dated path coupling in queue_ops.py, projected-only cap checks in ledger.py, and exact-string canary grading in grade_canary3.py. Freezing worker expansion and focusing budget on P5 Pareto experiments is the cleanest path.
